sdk.installScripts: not run (npm allow-scripts); none was needed

workerLossDuringAnEffect.method: an activity sleeping 3 s, its worker killed with SIGKILL 1.2 s in, a new worker started

threeAttempts.reading: a retry repeats an external effect: retries must not be used for effects

workerLossDuringAnEffect.updates: the same update id sent twice returned the same result once; an update after completion was refused

afterTheSplit.processEnvReference: the Redactor's default parameter, never evaluated: the kernel passes an empty environment; evaluating it in the sandbox would throw

findings: Replaying a retained graph history consulted the reading host's environment for credentials (decision and Send text, plan and grant), so a valid record could become unreadable on another machine; red-first tests reproduced it before the fix.
Temporal's disallowed-module check reads imports as written, so node:crypto is replaced at bundle time by a pure SHA-256 and listed as ignored; tests compare it with node:crypto.

npm placed protobufjs 7.6.6 (for @grpc/proto-loader) at the top level and three separate copies of 8.8.0 under the SDK packages; the SDK's JSON history reader failed with 'type must be a Type' until protobufjs 8.8.0 was pinned at the top level.
Bun's bundler left a module-level constant undefined in the compiled CLI when an async module initialiser was not awaited; the compiled walkthrough caught it and the constant became a function.
A Temporal dev server that suggests continue-as-new early exposed that a test-only fixed-clock workflow loses its clock across runs; production input carries no clock.

workflowInputSizes.temporalDefaultPayloadLimit: 2 MB, not measured near Wringer's own bounds
